### CVE-2019-6780
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2019-01-24 | Updated: 2024-08-04 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 46247: WordPress Plugin Wisechat 2.6.3 - Reverse Tabnabbing (webapps/php, 2019-01-25, verified=0)

The Wise Chat plugin before 2.7 for WordPress mishandles external links because rendering/filters/post/WiseChatLinksPostFilter.php omits noopener and noreferrer.

### CVE-2019-7441
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2019-03-20 | Updated: 2024-08-04 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 46632: WordPress Plugin PayPal Checkout Payment Gateway 1.6.8 - Parameter Tampering (webapps/php, 2019-04-02, verified=0)

cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_cart in the WooCommerce PayPal Checkout Payment Gateway plugin 1.6.8 for WordPress allows Parameter Tampering in an amount parameter (such as amount_1), as demonstrated by purchasing an item for lower than the intended price. NOTE: The plugin author states it is true that the amount can be manipulated in the PayPal payment flow. However, the amount is validated against the WooCommerce order total before completing the order, and if it doesn’t match then the order will be left in an “On Hold” state

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

References:
- https://gkaim.com/cve-2019-7441-vikas-chaudhary/ [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://www.exploit-db.com/exploits/46632/ [exploit,x_refsource_EXPLOIT-DB]
- http://packetstormsecurity.com/files/152362/WordPress-PayPal-Checkout-Payment-Gateway-1.6.8-Parameter-Tampering.html [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://wordpress.org/support/topic/vulnerabilty-in-plugin/#post-11899173 [x_refsource_MISC]

### CVE-2019-8942
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2019-02-20 | Updated: 2024-08-04 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 46662: WordPress Core 5.0.0 - Crop-image Shell Upload (Metasploit) (remote/php, 2019-04-05, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 46511: WordPress Core 5.0 - Remote Code Execution (webapps/php, 2019-03-01, verified=0)

WordPress before 4.9.9 and 5.x before 5.0.1 allows remote code execution because an _wp_attached_file Post Meta entry can be changed to an arbitrary string, such as one ending with a .jpg?file.php substring. An attacker with author privileges can execute arbitrary code by uploading a crafted image containing PHP code in the Exif metadata. Exploitation can leverage CVE-2019-8943.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

### CVE-2019-8943
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2019-02-20 | Updated: 2024-08-04 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 46662: WordPress Core 5.0.0 - Crop-image Shell Upload (Metasploit) (remote/php, 2019-04-05, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 46511: WordPress Core 5.0 - Remote Code Execution (webapps/php, 2019-03-01, verified=0)

WordPress through 5.0.3 allows Path Traversal in wp_crop_image(). An attacker (who has privileges to crop an image) can write the output image to an arbitrary directory via a filename containing two image extensions and ../ sequences, such as a filename ending with the .jpg?/../../file.jpg substring.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

### CVE-2019-13344
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2019-07-05 | Updated: 2024-08-04 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 47078: WordPress Plugin Like Button 1.6.0 - Authentication Bypass (webapps/php, 2019-07-08, verified=0)

An authentication bypass vulnerability in the CRUDLab WP Like Button plugin through 1.6.0 for WordPress allows unauthenticated attackers to change settings. The contains() function in wp_like_button.php did not check if the current request is made by an authorized user, thus allowing any unauthenticated user to successfully update settings, as demonstrated by the wp-admin/admin.php?page=facebook-like-button each_page_url or code_snippet parameter.

- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

The Easy WP SMTP plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in versions up to, and including, 1.3.9. ### CVE-2019-25217 — SiteGround Optimizer <= 5.0.12 - Missing Authorization
- Assigner: Wordfence | Published: 2024-10-16 | Updated: 2026-04-08 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: CWE-862 CWE-862 Missing Authorization
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

The SiteGround Optimizer plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass leading to Remote Code Execution and Local File Inclusion in versions up to, and including, 5.0.12 due to incorrect use of an access control attribute on the switch_php function called via the /switch-php REST API route. This allows attackers to include and execute arbitrary files on the server, allowing the execution of any PHP code in those files. This can be used to bypass access controls, obtain sensitive data, or achieve code execution in cases where images and other “safe” file types can be uploaded and included.

Affected:
- siteground / Speed Optimizer – The All-In-One Performance-Boosting Plugin: affected 0 <5.0.13 (semver)
- siteground / speed_optimizer: affected 0 <5.0.13 (semver)

Credits: Marc-Alexandre Montpas

References:
